tams_title: TAMS - Testing and Assessment Management Solution
tams_description: A comprehensive platform for creating, delivering, and managing tests and assessments. TAMS provides robust tools for educators to evaluate student performance effectively.
tams_kp1: Create diverse question types, from multiple-choice to essays.
tams_kp2: Securely administer exams with anti-cheating features.
tams_kp3: Automated grading and detailed performance analytics.
tams_kp4: Integrate with existing learning management systems.
tams_kp5: Customizable to fit your institution's needs.
aiquest_description: Leverage the power of artificial intelligence to automatically generate high-quality questions from your course materials. Save time and create diverse assessments effortlessly.
aiquest_kp1: Generate questions from text, documents, and URLs.
aiquest_kp2: Supports various difficulty levels and cognitive skills.
aiquest_kp3: Ensures a wide range of question types for comprehensive testing.
aiquest_kp4: Reduces manual effort and streamlines content creation.
lms_description: A fully-featured Learning Management System to host your courses, manage users, and track learning progress. Our LMS is designed for engagement and ease of use.
lms_kp1: Host and organize course content, including videos, documents, and quizzes.
lms_kp2: Manage user enrollment, roles, and permissions.
lms_kp3: Track student progress and generate reports.
lms_kp4: Facilitate communication through forums and messaging.
lms_kp5: Customizable branding and theme to match your identity.
open_source_support_description: Leverage the power of open-source without the maintenance overhead. We offer comprehensive support for a wide range of existing open-source applications commonly used in education, ensuring they run smoothly, securely, and efficiently within your environment. From learning management systems (LMS) to student information systems (SIS) and beyond, we've got you covered.
system_integration_description: Connecting disparate systems is crucial for operational efficiency. We specialize in integrating your various platforms – LMS, SIS, financial systems, authentication services (like LDAP or SSO), and more. Our expertise ensures data flows seamlessly and securely across your institution, reducing manual work and improving data accuracy.
system_integration_kp3: Single Sign-On (SSO) implementation (SAML, CAS, OIDC, OAuth)
custom_software_description: When off-the-shelf solutions don't meet your unique needs, our custom development team can build tailored applications from the ground up. We work closely with you to understand your requirements and deliver robust, scalable, and maintainable software using modern technologies.
tech_stack_kp1: Backend Development: Java, Python, Go, PHP
tech_stack_kp2: Frontend Development: Modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Vue, Svelte)
tech_stack_kp3: Database Management: SQL and NoSQL databases
tech_stack_kp4: Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud
automation_reporting_description: Streamline workflows and gain valuable insights with our automation and reporting services. We develop custom scripts, automated data feeds, and comprehensive reports to simplify administrative tasks and support data-driven decision-making.
automation_reporting_kp2: Development of automated reports and data feeds
automation_reporting_kp3: Implementation of real-time monitoring with triggers and alerts
automation_reporting_kp5: Dashboard creation for key performance indicators (KPIs)
